name: TM36
description: Hurls sludge at the foe. It may poison the foe.

gifts.note: Not here until Badge 5. This man is not in Dewford Hall at first. He appears only after you beat your Dad at the Petalburg Gym (Badge 5), and then gives you the Sludge Bomb TM the first time you talk to him. The Lavaridge Gym's TM Package 4 (Badge 4) already includes Sludge Bomb, so this is a spare copy.

Beat the Lavaridge Gym Leader (Badge 4). After the battle you get the Mega Ring, which lets you Mega Evolve, and TM Package 4 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case). If your Bag had no room, talk to the Leader again.
